changes: Redesigned Clock Editor with a canvas-first layout and contextual editing tabs.
Movable, resizable floating Element panel, bottom docking, and transparency while editing.
Multi-layer selection, batch transforms, alignment guides, snapping, and Smart Layout spacing tools.
Named layer groups, group duplication, and a reusable My Widgets library.
Portable widget sharing and importing.
Per-layer tap actions for apps, alarms, timers, battery settings, and music controls—with safe preview testing.
Wallpaper Depth effects with editable subject placement and presets based on built-in wallpapers.
On-device photo auto-cutout using ML Kit subject segmentation.
Multi-plane gyroscope parallax and finger-drag “peek behind” gestures.
Image-filled shapes with crop, zoom, and positioning controls.
Continuous image fills spanning multiple selected shapes.
Additional geometric shapes and individual corner-radius controls.
Gradient colors, directional gradient tint, transparency, and tint-opacity controls.
iOS-inspired glass text styling, curved/arc text, and Kinetic Text.
Advanced animations including Levitate, Orbit, Hologram, Elastic Drift, Glitch, Figure Eight, Pendulum, Jelly, and Pulse Bloom.
Online font browsing and downloading.
Nothing-inspired widgets, animated Glyph Eyes, and iOS-inspired clock, calendar, battery, and system-information cards.
Layer-editable user-info, next-alarm, battery, memory, storage, uptime, and weather widgets.
Expanded music-widget styles, playback controls, audio-reactive visualization, and album-art color adaptation where available.
Configurable weather updates, animated weather icons, and atmospheric effects including rain, snow, fog, stars, sunbeams, and fireflies.
Customizable AOD-to-lockscreen typography transitions.
JingMatrix/Vector framework compatibility and an updated installation-progress screen.
Fixed blank editor canvases, disappearing elements after selection, and undo/redo issues.
Corrected clock positioning and scaling between the editor, preview, and lockscreen.
Fixed clipped clocks, text, shadows, glows, and template previews.
Fixed depth-wallpaper cropping and black gaps at the bottom of the lockscreen.
Synchronized newly added elements and widgets with the current depth/gyro position.
Fixed lockscreen shape image fills and asset loading.
Fixed floating-panel dragging, excessive padding, scrolling, and editor-control obstruction.
Kept the app navigation bar hidden inside the Clock Editor.
Limited Center H, Center V, and Stack V operations to selected layers.
Fixed arc-text orientation, distortion, centering, and long-text fitting.
Fixed gradient rendering with animated text and removed unwanted opaque template backgrounds.
Replaced simulated widget readings with real data; unavailable readings now display clearly.
Fixed widget alignment, overlapping labels, alarm details, weather freshness, and temperature-unit handling.
Preserved music-card colors in AOD and improved tap-action unlock handoff.
Improved clock/widget packages to preserve images, fonts, depth assets, animations, gradients, groups, and scene settings.

Redesigned tap gestures with neutral, clean highlights on home buttons.

Fixed custom header clock showing in the wrong places and improved stock clock hiding.
